Krea alternatives

Krea: Real-time image generation as you draw, plus upscaling and many models in one place. If it isn't quite right, here are 14 other AI image generators and editors from Radar, in Radar's order.

  1. 1MidjourneyStill the one for striking, art-directed images, and now short videos too.Paid
  2. 2IdeogramImage generation that gets the lettering right, posters, logos, covers.Free plan
  3. 3FLUXBlack Forest Labs' image models for generating and editing, some with open weights.Free plan
  4. 4Adobe FireflyAdobe's image and video models, made to be safe for commercial work.Free plan
  5. 5ComfyUINode-based workflows for open image and video models, run on your own GPU.Open source
  6. 6LeonardoImage and video generation with fine control for game art and design.Free plan
  7. 7RecraftBrand-consistent images and real vector graphics, icons and mockups.Free plan
  8. 8OpenArtMany image and video models in one studio, with characters that stay consistent.Free plan
  9. 9MagnificUpscales and re-imagines pictures, adding detail that wasn't there.Paid
  10. 10PhotoroomProduct photos in seconds: background removal, new scenes, batch edits.Free plan
  11. 11FreepikAn AI suite of the latest image and video models next to a huge stock library.Free plan
  12. 12Stability AIThe makers of Stable Diffusion: image, video, 3D and audio models.Free plan
  13. 13PlaygroundAI graphic design for logos, posters and social posts from templates.Free plan
  14. 14NightCafeA friendly AI art studio with many models and a big community.Free plan

Free to start: Ideogram, FLUX, Adobe Firefly.
